Description: Domain Knowledge Retrieval for a Connected Autonomous Vehicle: the Domain Knowledge of the Domain Type CAV - what CAV-TEC V2.0 says a passenger can ask of a CAV and what it tells, with the terms of the domain and the words of a passenger as Synonyms - is the file of its Access (Setting DomainKnowledge); the Domain Knowledge received on its Port is that of the Domain Instance, the places of the CAV from its Offline Map. Both are searched together. First version: BM25 over the words of the items, no model; an item whose Name or one of whose Synonyms the request says is always relevant. Setting Items: how many at most (6).

AccessSources.Name: DomainKnowledge
AccessSources.Description: The Domain Knowledge of the Domain Type CAV (MMC-DKN-V2.5), from the web pages of CAV-TEC V2.0: its Terms and Definitions, its Architecture, the AMS-HCI Message and the Route Data Types - only what concerns a human; the words of a passenger are the Synonyms.
